response.overview: Statistical Hallucination is a tribute to Chris Marker's film La Jetée (1962), a story about a time traveler obsessed with an image from his past, to produce this statistical hallucination generated with artificial intelligence systems. Instead of Jean Négroni's voice, we now have a synthetic voice. In place of photographs of a post-apocalyptic Paris, there are those imagined by an artificial intelligence. What will the images of the future be?
response.title: Statistical Hallucination
